title: Momentum in two dimensions
target: Conserve momentum separately along perpendicular axes.
criteria: Add momentum components along matching directions.
Connect component sums to the final motion.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: For a horizontal collision, which coordinate choice is valid?
options: Remove all signs because there are two axes.
Define east as +x and north as +y for every object.
Treat all northward momentum as x momentum.
Use east as positive for one object and west for another without converting.
cpa.guide: Use a consistent pair of perpendicular axes.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: With east +x and north +y, a momentum points southwest. What signs do its components have?
cpa.guide: West is negative x; south is negative y.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: Object A has momentum components (8, 3), and B has (−2, 5), in kg·m/s. What is total momentum?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: Total initial y momentum is −9 kg·m/s. After an isolated collision, one object has y momentum −4. What is the other’s y momentum?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: Objects stick with total mass 5 kg and total momentum (15, −20) kg·m/s. What are final velocity components?
cpa.guide: Divide each momentum component by the combined mass.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A joined object has velocity components +3 m/s east and −4 m/s north. What are its speed and general direction?
cpa.guide: Speed = √(3² + 4²) = 5; positive x and negative y mean southeast.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.
